title: Apple will limit Mac disk access as AI agents ‘substantially’ increase risk
description:
Apple will add new limits for "full disk access" on Mac in response to risks posed by AI agents, as reported earlier by TechCrunch. In an update on Friday, Apple says it's rolling out new controls to "ensure that users who genuinely wish to grant an app this extraordinary level of access can only do so with very explicit user action."
The change comes just weeks after Inc's Jason Aten found that Meta's Muse AI somehow knew the contents of his messages, despite not giving the chatbot explicit permission to access them on his iPhone or Mac. Meta spokesperson Andy Stone pushed back on this report, saying access to Messages is "entirely opt-in. …
Read the full story at The Verge.

I recently turned 40, and I don’t need reminding that both time and my chronological age only tick forward. But this game is focused on competitors’ biological ages—figures that are meant to provide a better way to measure…

Ich bin vor kurzem 40 geworden und muss nicht daran erinnert werden, dass sowohl die Zeit als auch mein chronologisches Alter nur vorwärts ticken. Aber dieses Spiel konzentriert sich auf das biologische Alter der Teilnehmer – Zahlen, die gemeint sind ...
titleDE: In einem neuen Wettbewerb treten Teilnehmer im Wettlauf um die biologische Jugend gegeneinander an

Zug 37 in der zweiten Partie des Fünf-Partien-Spiels sah so absurd aus, dass einige Kommentatoren dachten, es sei ein…

description: If you want to install a big battery in New York City, you have to cut through a notoriously tough tangle of regulations. That’s made it difficult to get large energy storage projects on the grid. Faced with those obstacles, some startups are getting creative, finding ways to use relatively small batteries in unexpected places,…
